families.axis: an impression that registers → an impression that overwhelms

members.gloss: making a strong or vivid impression
members.tone: The family's plain measure of approval - something lands strongly, with none of the claim to flatten you that *staggering* makes.

members.gloss: inspiring awe or admiration or wonder
members.tone: Unguarded warmth, all wonder and no weight, where *awe-inspiring* holds the same admiration at arm's length.

members.gloss: inspiring awe or admiration or wonder
members.tone: Formal, and it names the effect instead of voicing it - it reports what a thing does to an onlooker where *amazing* simply exclaims.

members.gloss: inspiring awe or admiration or wonder
members.tone: Names the reaction rather than the quality that provoked it - the response is the whole of the claim.

members.gloss: inspiring awe or admiration or wonder
members.tone: Sits at the awe end of this sense - the impression overpowers rather than pleases, which is the whole distance between it and *amazing*.

members.gloss: inspiring awe or admiration or wonder
members.tone: A flat participle that states the effect and stops, carrying none of the speaker's own delight that *awesome* puts on show.

members.gloss: commanding attention
members.tone: Attention is seized and held - it stops you mid-stride, where *impressive* only invites you to admire at your leisure.

members.gloss: commanding attention
members.tone: The attention is commanded by display, and the word grants that the display worked.

members.gloss: commanding attention
members.tone: Commands attention by knocking it loose - the looking is involuntary, not the considered halt of *arresting*.

members.gloss: so surprisingly impressive as to stun or overwhelm
members.tone: Surprise is the mechanism here: it overwhelms because it exceeds what you were braced for, not because it is merely large.

members.gloss: so surprisingly impressive as to stun or overwhelm
members.tone: A heavier landing than *astonishing* - the surprise does not just register, it takes the ground out from under.

members.gloss: so surprisingly impressive as to stun or overwhelm
members.tone: The overwhelm is bodily - it arrives as weight and puts you off balance, where *astonishing* works on the expectations instead.

members.gloss: so surprisingly impressive as to stun or overwhelm
members.tone: The stun taken to its blank end, where the mind goes slack rather than sharp, so the admiration comes dulled.

members.gloss: impressive in size, manner, or appearance
members.tone: Grandeur with rank in it - the scale reads as lordly, claiming consequence rather than just filling space.

members.gloss: impressive in size, manner, or appearance
members.tone: Impressiveness that presses down on the onlooker, commanding respect from a slight distance and closer to daunting than to inviting.

members.gloss: impressive in size, manner, or appearance
members.tone: The bulk or bearing reads as dignity, an elevation of quality, where *imposing* achieves its effect by weight alone.

families.axis: feeling merely aroused → deep feeling that gladdens, rouses or disquiets

members.gloss: arousing or capable of arousing deep emotion
members.tone: The plainest full-strength term here — it credits depth of feeling without saying what the feeling is, where *heartwarming* and *haunting* each name its colour.

members.gloss: arousing affect
members.tone: The barest of the three that share this sense — it reports that feeling was produced and stops there, where *poignant* and *touching* each put a force behind it.

members.gloss: arousing affect
members.tone: The keenest of the three — the feeling it names arrives with an edge, where *touching* arrives softly.

members.gloss: arousing affect
members.tone: The mildest of the three — a small stir of feeling rather than the keen pull *poignant* exerts.

members.gloss: having a deeply disquieting or disturbing effect
members.tone: The one member whose effect is unwelcome — it credits real depth while naming the disturbance, where *heartwarming* credits only the pleasure.

members.gloss: causing gladness and pleasure
members.tone: Unmixed warmth — the only member that guarantees the feeling is a glad one, where *moving* leaves the kind of emotion open.

members.gloss: exciting strong but not unpleasant emotions
members.tone: Rousing rather than tender — it makes the emotion strong and forward-moving while ruling out the discomfort *haunting* trades in.

members.gloss: exciting strong but not unpleasant emotions
members.tone: The emphatic form of the same sense — it puts the whole self behind the feeling *stirring* merely raises.

families.axis: plain quickness of mind → shrewdness honed by self-interest and survival

members.gloss: showing mental alertness and calculation and resourcefulness
members.tone: The family's plain approving term - alertness and resourcefulness credited straight, with none of the self-interested edge *cagey* carries.

members.gloss: marked by practical hardheaded intelligence
members.tone: Praise for judgement that sees through a situation, formal in register and weightier than *sharp*, which credits speed instead.

members.gloss: marked by practical hardheaded intelligence
members.tone: The same practical intelligence as *astute*, but felt as quickness and edge rather than depth.

members.gloss: marked by practical hardheaded intelligence
members.tone: Approves the hardheaded part out loud, so the compliment comes with a coolness *astute* does not have.

members.gloss: showing self-interest and shrewdness in dealing with others
members.tone: Credits the shrewdness while flagging the guardedness - intelligence held close and used defensively, which is why the approval is only half given.

members.gloss: showing self-interest and shrewdness in dealing with others
members.tone: An alternate spelling carrying exactly the force of *cagey*, wariness and self-interest both.

members.gloss: showing self-interest and shrewdness in dealing with others
members.tone: Makes the self-interest sound like sound sense rather than concealment, warming what *cagey* leaves guarded.

members.gloss: showing self-interest and shrewdness in dealing with others
members.tone: The double-edged member - it grants the quickness while letting the self-interest show, so it can compliment and needle in one word.

members.gloss: having the shrewd resourcefulness needed to survive in an urban environment
members.tone: Respect for intelligence proved under pressure rather than taught - resourcefulness measured by whether it keeps a person going in a city.

members.gloss: having the shrewd resourcefulness needed to survive in an urban environment
members.tone: Says what *streetwise* says with the parts laid bare, the street and the smartness named separately, which makes it land blunter.

members.gloss: having the shrewd resourcefulness needed to survive in an urban environment
members.tone: Informal and light, it makes the same survival-sharpness sound like being clued in rather than hardened by it.

families.axis: merely not of the present moment → wholly finished and out of use

members.gloss: not current or belonging to the present time
members.tone: The flattest term here - a bare negation of present-day standing, without the verdict *obsolete* passes.

members.gloss: of an earlier date
members.tone: Purely positional - it sets something at an earlier date and judges nothing about it.

members.gloss: no longer having force or relevance
members.tone: Blunt and absolute - force and relevance are gone outright, not ebbing as in *obsolescent*.

members.gloss: no longer in use
members.tone: States the plain fact of non-use and leaves the reason alone.

members.gloss: no longer in use
members.tone: The same non-use as *disused*, but delivered as a verdict rather than an observation.

members.gloss: old; no longer valid or fashionable
members.tone: Faults the thing for its age, withdrawing validity and fashion in one stroke.

members.gloss: old; no longer valid or fashionable
members.tone: Plain and unemphatic - it reports the same lapse *outdated* reports, with less of the reproach.

members.gloss: old; no longer valid or fashionable
members.tone: Formal and faintly withering - age is treated as having disqualified the thing.

members.gloss: becoming obsolete
members.tone: Marks the slide rather than the arrival - on its way to what *obsolete* already is.

families.axis: a wrong opinion recorded → conduct deserving severe censure

members.gloss: contrary to conscience or morality or law
members.tone: The family's flat verdict, condemning without heat and reaching conscience, morality and law with the same single word.

members.gloss: bringing or deserving severe rebuke or censure
members.tone: States the desert rather than colouring it - the thing has earned rebuke, and the word says so and stops.

members.gloss: bringing or deserving severe rebuke or censure
members.tone: Puts the weight of a legal charge behind a censure that is moral rather than legal, which makes it an outcry where *condemnable* is a ruling.

members.gloss: bringing or deserving severe rebuke or censure
members.tone: Voices the disapproval as dismay - the thing is bad enough to be lamented, not merely bad enough to be rebuked.

members.gloss: bringing or deserving severe rebuke or censure
members.tone: Formal and judicial in weight, handing the blame down as a finding rather than an outburst - the cold end of *criminal*.

members.gloss: bringing or deserving severe rebuke or censure
members.tone: Puts the fault in the thing itself rather than in the verdict on it, imputing wickedness where *reprehensible* only assigns blame.

members.gloss: not adhering to ethical or moral principles
members.tone: Contemptuous - it ranks the character as low, not merely at fault, where *immoral* records the failure and leaves the person's standing alone.

members.gloss: not adhering to ethical or moral principles
members.tone: The flat categorical charge: measured against a standard and found outside it, with the force sitting in the standard rather than in the tone.

members.gloss: wrong in e.g. opinion or judgment
members.tone: Faults the judgment while leaving the intention unblamed - being led wrong is a softer charge than being wrong.

members.gloss: wrong in e.g. opinion or judgment
members.tone: Records the error and nothing else, no reproach attaching, where *misguided* still suggests the opinion was badly arrived at.

families.axis: plainly made rather than natural → so made it has no substance behind it

members.gloss: contrived by art rather than nature
members.tone: The family's flat baseline: it says a thing was contrived rather than grown and stops there, where *unreal* goes on to deny it.

members.gloss: contrived by art rather than nature
members.tone: Sets the made thing against the natural one, so what it withholds is naturalness rather than existence.

members.gloss: deliberately arranged for effect
members.tone: Names the deliberation and no more — the effect was composed, which is a fact before it is a complaint.

members.gloss: deliberately arranged for effect
members.tone: Makes that arrangement a performance put on for an onlooker, so what looked spontaneous reads as put-up — the accusation *arranged* stops short of.

members.gloss: having particular physiological functions augmented or replaced by electronic or electromechanical components
members.tone: Strictly technical — it reports function augmented or replaced by machinery and carries none of the deficiency the rest of the family hangs on the made.

members.gloss: (used of color) artificially produced; not natural
members.tone: Colour got by stripping rather than adding, and the word keeps the drained, washed-out feel of that.

members.gloss: (used of color) artificially produced; not natural
members.tone: The blankest of these — the colour was put there, with no hint of how or how deep.

members.gloss: (used of color) artificially produced; not natural
members.tone: The British spelling, identical in force to *colored*: applied colour, stated without comment.

members.gloss: (used of color) artificially produced; not natural
members.tone: Puts the colour in deep rather than on the surface, more concrete than *colored* and no harsher for it.

members.gloss: without substance
members.tone: Withering — the thing is flat, propped up, and has nothing behind it.

members.gloss: without substance
members.tone: A plain report of the shortfall, measuring the thing against life and finding it thin, with none of *cardboard*'s contempt.

members.gloss: artificial as if portrayed in a film
members.tone: Gives the thing the sheen of a screen image and the same nothing behind the surface.

members.gloss: artificial as if portrayed in a film
members.tone: Manufactured-feeling rather than lived — the same screen-thin unreality as *celluloid*, without the sheen.

members.gloss: using artistic forms and conventions to create effects; not natural or spontaneous
members.tone: Says the form was settled by convention rather than felt in the moment — cool and analytic, a shortfall of spontaneity rather than of substance.

members.gloss: using artistic forms and conventions to create effects; not natural or spontaneous
members.tone: The British spelling, carrying exactly the measured, analytic weight of *conventionalized*.

members.gloss: using artistic forms and conventions to create effects; not natural or spontaneous
members.tone: The one here that can name a deliberate artistic manner rather than a failure, where *unlifelike* is only a falling short.

families.axis: bare shortfall from perfect → a fault that spoils and discredits the thing

members.gloss: not perfect; defective or inadequate
members.tone: The plain word for falling short of perfect - it states the shortfall and stops there, without *defective*'s implication that something inside has gone wrong.

members.gloss: having a blemish or flaw
members.tone: Puts the fault on the surface - a mark on something otherwise sound, where *flawed* lets the fault run through it.

members.gloss: having a blemish or flaw
members.tone: The same defect read as structural rather than a spot, which is why it lands harder than *blemished*.

members.gloss: imperfectly spoken or written
members.tone: Grades speech or writing as falling short of fluent - a shortfall in the language itself, not *defective*'s fault built into a thing.

members.gloss: containing errors or alterations
members.tone: Says errors and alterations have got in, so the thing can no longer be trusted as it stands - heavier than *flawed*, which admits a fault without unsettling the whole.

members.gloss: containing errors or alterations
members.tone: The participle points back at a sound original that errors have since entered, where *corrupt* simply reports the state.

members.gloss: having a defect
members.tone: Names the defect as a verdict on the whole item - colder and more final than *faulty*.

members.gloss: having a defect
members.tone: Workaday and remediable - it locates a fault to be put right rather than writing the thing off the way *defective* does.

members.gloss: capable of being made imperfect
members.tone: Purely a statement of capacity - it says imperfection could be introduced and passes no judgement, where *defective* and *corrupt* both condemn.

members.gloss: failing to meet a standard of manufacture due to an imperfection
members.tone: Grades an item as missing the standard of manufacture, registering the imperfection while cushioning it - far short of calling it *defective*.

families.axis: a favorable outcome stated as plain fact → success loud enough to be proclaimed

members.gloss: having succeeded or being marked by a favorable outcome
members.tone: The family's flat statement that the outcome went well, carrying none of the swagger *boffo* brings to the same result.

members.gloss: resoundingly successful and popular
members.tone: Informal and exuberant - a hit rather than a result, success that arrives with applause attached.

members.gloss: very lively and profitable
members.tone: Profit heard as noise, busy enough to be audible, where *flourishing* keeps its liveliness quiet.

members.gloss: very lively and profitable
members.tone: Liveliness figured as healthy growth, organic where *booming* is loud.

members.gloss: very lively and profitable
members.tone: Ornate and faintly grand, giving profitable liveliness a costume that *thriving* does without.

members.gloss: very lively and profitable
members.tone: The participle keeps the gain in motion - still climbing, where *prosperous* names a state already reached.

members.gloss: very lively and profitable
members.tone: Settled rather than surging: comfortable profit as a condition, not a rush.

members.gloss: very lively and profitable
members.tone: The loudest word in the set - profit at full volume, and it refuses to be understated.

members.gloss: very lively and profitable
members.tone: Vitality as the measure of profit, doing well the way a living thing does and with none of *roaring*'s noise.

members.gloss: very lively and profitable
members.tone: Swelling growth caught mid-expansion, promising more where *prosperous* implies arrival.

members.gloss: holding office
members.tone: Purely positional - it records that the office is held and passes no judgement on the holding.

members.gloss: successful or assured of success
members.tone: Blunt finality: the success is banked and out of doubt, unlike *sure-fire*, which is confident about what has yet to happen.

members.gloss: of a game (or the pitching) in which a pitcher allows the opponent no hits
members.tone: A technical description of what the pitching allowed, recording the fact where the rest of the family evaluates.

members.gloss: yielding positive results
members.tone: Measured, almost accounting approval - results were yielded, with none of *boffo*'s noise about them.

members.gloss: having achieved success or recognition by your own efforts
members.tone: Approval aimed at the person rather than the outcome, crediting the effort behind the success.

members.gloss: certain to be successful
members.tone: Confidence issued in advance, guaranteeing a success that *made* can already report as done.
